sloka: न तावत्कृतकृत्यो ऽस्मि विषयेषु नरर्षभ ।अनुभूय तदा कामं ततः प्राप्स्याम्यहं जराम् ।। ७.५९.३ ॥
transliteration: na tāvatkṛtakṛtyo 'smi viṣayeṣu nararṣabha ।anubhūya tadā kāmaṁ tataḥ prāpsyāmyahaṁ jarām ।। 7.59.3 ॥

translations.english: Yayati continued, "O best among men, I am not yet satisfied with worldly pleasures; only after fully experiencing my desires will I then accept old age."
